meta.notes: 9-week strength plan bridging White River (7/25) to Vermont 50K (9/27), implementing the connective-tissue bridge (W1-2 recover/no HSR -> W3-6 build HSR + specialize -> W7 last heavy -> W8-9 isometric taper) and the handoff P1 scope: (a) right-foot pronation program [foot_correctives daily routine], (b) Achilles + calf complex HSR/isometrics [Lower A calf slot + Lower B soleus HSR + evening micro-dose], (c) peroneal/lateral-ankle loading — the June injury site [isometric W1-2 -> loaded slow-resistance W3+ in Lower B, always sub-symptom], (d) knee & hip stability incl. LATERAL CHAIN [hip_lateral_activation daily + lateral step-downs, Copenhagen planks, glute-med work in sessions]. HILL STRENGTH IS CO-EQUAL WITH TENDON WORK (Addendum 2a): Lower A (Tue) = hill strength — eccentric quads, unilateral climbing drive, heavy calf; Lower B (Thu) = tendon HSR + lateral chain + proprioception; the evening isometric micro-dose supplies tendon FREQUENCY on non-session days (the 'more frequent, shorter exposures' resolution of 2c). Gym eccentric work is NOT gated by P3 — it starts Week 3; only on-terrain descent volume is gated. SSC/reactive layer: low-amplitude pogo hops enter Lower B in W5-7, gated on right forefoot AND lateral ankle, first thing pulled on any complaint; Vermont's rolling profile wants elastic tendons but moderate-descent running supplies most of the SSC stimulus, so the plyo dose stays small. SESSIONS: W1-2 3/wk (2 lower-entry + 1 upper), W3-7 4/wk (2L+2U), W8 2/wk, W9 1 isometric session. DOUBLE-DAY RULES: lower body = PM double after Tue hill intervals (hard-with-hard valid for muscular work) and Thu runs; NO lower-body strength day-of or day-before the Sunday long run (upper OK Saturday); run before strength always, 4+ h gap. Age-50 recovery criteria: drop a session (Upper B first, then reduce Lower A load — never skip Lower B tendon work) when 2 of: resting HR +7 bpm, sleep under 6 h twice in 3 days, persistent soreness beyond 48h. KNEE GATE: eccentric quad work never first; bodyweight step-down check in pre_lower before any loaded step work. NO NSAIDs around loading sessions. NEW THIS VERSION: post_strength cooldown split into post_lower and post_upper (pending item from last cycle, now built). COMPLIANCE MECHANISM: every P1 item is a named, tracked session or routine; Sunday weekly compliance check in every week's notes; two missed P1 items in a week = message the coach. Home gym: barbell, squat rack, dumbbells, pull-up/pull-down bar, cable row, bands, box.

daily_routines.title: Foot & Arch Correctives (pronation program)

exercises.name: Short-foot activation
exercises.cue: Barefoot. Lift the arch without curling toes.

exercises.name: Toe yoga
exercises.cue: Big toe down, little toes up; then reverse.

exercises.name: Heel walks
exercises.cue: Toes up, walk on heels across the room.

exercises.name: Big-toe extension mobilization
exercises.cue: Kneel, toes tucked, gentle sit-back. Big-toe range for push-off.

exercises.name: Calf raise with eversion bias
exercises.cue: Rise with slight outward pressure — anti-pronation pattern.

daily_routines.notes: NON-NEGOTIABLE, every day of the block. This is P1 component (a). Pair with the daily collagen + vitamin C dose (see nutrition plan) so the connective tissue gets a signaled stimulus daily.

daily_routines.title: Hip & Lateral-Chain Activation

exercises.name: Clamshells (band)
exercises.cue: Pelvis still; open from the hip.

exercises.name: Side-lying hip abduction
exercises.cue: Heel leads, toe slightly down — glute med, not TFL.

exercises.name: Banded lateral walk
exercises.cue: Athletic stance, steps controlled both directions.

exercises.name: Single-leg balance reach
exercises.cue: Stand on one leg, reach the free foot to 3 points of a clock.

daily_routines.notes: P1 component (d) daily floor: the lateral-stability chain (pronating right foot -> lateral ankle -> lateral knee) gets touched every morning; the loaded version lives in Lower B.

exercises.name: Band pull-aparts
exercises.cue: Squeeze shoulder blades; no shrug.

exercises.name: Band external rotation
exercises.cue: Elbow pinned to ribs. Left shoulder priority.

exercises.name: Scapular wall slides
exercises.cue: Forearms on wall, slide up without ribs flaring.

daily_routines.title: Evening Tendon Isometrics (micro-dose)

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise isometric hold
exercises.cue: Mid-range hold, fingertips on wall.

exercises.name: Resisted eversion isometric (band)
exercises.cue: June injury site — daily gentle signal, never provocation. Both sides; right +1 set.

exercises.name: Tibialis raises
exercises.cue: Wall lean, toes up.

phase_overrides.modification: Effort easy, holds 20-30 s, skip entirely on any day the sites feel reactive.

daily_routines.notes: Tendon loading responds to FREQUENCY more than per-session volume (Addendum 2c). This micro-dose is the 'more frequent, shorter lower-body exposures' resolution: skip it on Lower A/B days (the session covers it).

exercises.name: Foot tripod + short-foot set
exercises.cue: Barefoot or socks. Set the arch before loading it.

exercises.name: Ankle dorsiflexion rocks
exercises.cue: Half-kneel, knee over toes, heel down. Descent-mobility priority.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: 2 s squeeze at top.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.cue: Slow and full range; the knee-gate warmup — no loaded knee work until these feel silent.

exercises.name: Bodyweight step-down (low box)
exercises.cue: Final knee check before any loaded step work.

pre_lower.notes: KNEE GATE lives here: loaded step-downs/step-ups only after the bodyweight versions are pain-free and the knee is warm.

exercises.name: Standing calf stretch (straight + bent knee)
exercises.cue: Both angles: gastroc and soleus.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
exercises.cue: Back glute on first, then lean.

exercises.name: Ankle dorsiflexion mobilization (wall)
exercises.cue: Knee to wall, heel down — bank the descent range while warm.

post_lower.notes: NEW post-lower split (replaces the old single post_strength). Lower-body specific: calves/ankle/hip get the cooldown minutes.

exercises.name: Thoracic opener over foam roller
exercises.cue: Gentle extension. Deprioritized vs last cycle (pole-driven need is gone) but kept as a short reset.

post_upper.notes: NEW post-upper split — short shoulder/torso reset.

sessions.title: Lower Entry A — Tendon Isometrics & Lateral Chain

exercises.name: Wall-sit isometric hold
exercises.cue: Shallow angle (~60 deg knee bend). Knee-gate: fully warm before this; keep depth pain-free.
exercises.progression_note: Add 10 s per week if pain-free.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise isometric hold (mid-range)
exercises.cue: Hold at mid-range on one leg, fingertips on wall for balance. Even pressure across the forefoot — do not roll to the little toes (pronation cue).
exercises.progression_note: Progress toward 45 s holds by Week 2.

exercises.name: Bent-knee soleus isometric hold
exercises.cue: Knee bent ~30 deg, heel high. Soleus carries descents — treat it as a separate tendon.

exercises.name: Resisted eversion isometric (band)
exercises.cue: Band around forefoot, press outward and HOLD. This is the June injury site (peroneal/lateral ankle) — effort stays at 'working, never provoking'.
exercises.notes: Do both sides; right gets an extra set.

exercises.name: Short-foot single-leg balance
exercises.cue: Barefoot, arch active, big toe down. Eyes forward.

exercises.name: Side plank with clamshell
exercises.cue: Lateral-chain opener: hips stacked, top knee opens against gravity.
exercises.notes: Lateral-stability hypothesis work — pronating foot, lateral ankle, lateral knee all sit on this chain.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.cue: Slow, no lumbar rotation.

sessions.notes: RECOVERY-PHASE SESSION: isometrics only, NO heavy slow resistance yet (tendon bridge weeks 1-2 = recover, no HSR). Everything sub-symptom. No NSAIDs around this or any loading session.

days.day_notes: Evening session after the recovery walk.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.cue: Light dumbbell. Re-groove the pattern, nothing more.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift (dumbbells)
exercises.cue: Hinge pattern rehearsal.

exercises.name: Lateral step-down (low box, bodyweight)
exercises.cue: Low box (6-8 in). Pelvis level, knee tracks over second toe. Off-axis control for the lateral chain.
exercises.notes: Knee-gate: only after full warmup; skip if left outer knee has spoken this week.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise isometric hold

exercises.name: Tibialis raises (wall lean)
exercises.cue: Toes up against wall lean. Front-of-shin control for descents.

exercises.cue: Slightly unstable surface. Ankles do small corrections — that is the point.

exercises.cue: 2 s hold.

sessions.title: Lower B — Tendon HSR & Lateral Chain

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise, bent knee (soleus HSR)
exercises.cue: Knee bent ~30 deg throughout. Soleus/Achilles complex under heavy slow load — the descent tendon builder.
exercises.progression_note: Progress load weekly while pain-free; 48h from any other heavy calf work.

exercises.name: Spanish squat isometric (band behind knees)
exercises.cue: Band anchored, shins vertical, sit back and HOLD. Patellar-tendon loading that the anterior knee history tolerates well.

exercises.name: Resisted eversion, heavy slow (band or cable)
exercises.cue: Slow controlled eversion against meaningful resistance — the peroneal/lateral-ankle rebuild, now loaded, not just isometric. Sub-symptom always; both sides, right +1 set.
exercises.progression_note: If any lateral-ankle response within 24h, revert to isometric holds for a week.

exercises.name: Tibialis raises (loaded)
exercises.cue: Add a light plate on the toes or use band resistance.

exercises.name: Lateral step-down
exercises.cue: Off-axis knee/hip control. Pelvis level — glute med owns this. Knee-gate applies.

exercises.name: Copenhagen plank (short lever)
exercises.cue: Adductor/lateral-chain isometric. Short lever (knee on bench).

exercises.name: Single-leg balance — unstable surface progression
exercises.cue: Folded mat -> pillow -> eyes-closed firm ground across the weeks. Foot/ankle proprioception for repeated footing adjustment.

sessions.notes: P1 flagship session. HSR responds to frequency — this session plus Tuesday's calf slot gives each tendon two quality exposures per week, 48h apart. Collagen + vitamin C 30-60 min before (see nutrition plan).
